parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the request and the response. The default value is **zh**. Valid values:

- **zh**: Chinese

- **en**: English

parameters.name: RecordId
parameters.description: The ID of the DNS record.<props="china"> Call the [DescribeDomainRecords](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomainrecords?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-search-29697.d_0) operation to obtain the record ID.</props><props="intl"> Call the [DescribeDomainRecords](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomainrecords?spm=a2c63.p38356.help-menu-search-29697.d_0) operation to obtain the record ID.</props>

parameters.name: Remark
parameters.description: The remarks for the DNS record. The default value is empty. If this parameter is left empty, the original remarks are deleted.
